tasks.title: Close every supported operation and model coverage row
tasks.goal: Make ETO/interface completeness a mechanically checked property of the delivered product.
steps: Re-enumerate actual public registrations and semantic model families after all initial and M-15 work, comparing sets rather than counts to the original coverage denominator.
Attach exact valid/invalid request, result, typed partial error, event and model examples plus executable external scenario evidence for every supported row.
Run generated schema checks and all coverage conformance; classify access-restricted/target-unsupported separately from unimplemented interfaces and keep the latter blocking.
positive_cases: Every delivered semantic capability has a strict external path and retained conformance case.
New registrations automatically produce a missing-coverage failure.
negative_cases: Deleting an inventory row makes an uncovered feature disappear.
A generic unsupported response or matching schema name counts as functional proof.
checks: CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-mcp target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-mcp <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-orchestrator target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-orchestrator <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.
TO CREATE/USE AFTER CREATION: coverage denominator and conformance check integrated in xtask; no invented pre-existing command.
acceptance: No supported feature/model exists only in CLI, TUI, prose log or private dump.
The exact coverage set includes all M-01 through M-15 results and semantic package rename.
tasks.safe_stop: Coverage is fully evidenced or explicit blockers remain; no hidden defer closes the campaign.

tasks.title: Publish the local developer machine contract
tasks.goal: Leave implementable client-neutral documentation and compatibility examples independent of temporary campaign files.
steps: Document actual framing/negotiation, context registration, schema epochs, identities, overlays/edit barriers, authority, submissions/events/replay/cancel and recovery from generated examples.
Publish a local capability compatibility matrix covering contexts/targets/providers and retained/debug schemas, with typed missing/redacted/expired states and exact conformance references.
Document the five full headless journeys and how future adapters consume shared services; do not propose IDE screens, plugin packaging, LSP/DAP implementation or MVP milestones.
positive_cases: A new external client can discover schemas and execute the proven admitted workflows from permanent documentation.
Retained evidence remains interpretable after provider/API exit.
negative_cases: Documentation sends readers to campaign tasks or personal settings for domain semantics.
A future-client roadmap replaces missing backend contracts.
checks: CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.
TO CREATE: documented-example conformance check against generated schemas and implemented protocol.
acceptance: Permanent developer documentation matches executable examples and all 26 owner decisions, with D-022's actual status explicit.
Root-owned promotion/retirement checks can remove the entire temporary campaign without breaking these contracts.
tasks.safe_stop: Local developer contract is complete and reviewable; no public publication or IDE implementation occurs.
